name: Aux Fuel Cars and Remote MU
author: ashenmare
description: Three cars that carry extra fuel and water, built on the game's own bodies: an Auxiliary Water Car and an Auxiliary Diesel Car (tank cars) and an Extra Tender (P-43 tender, coal and water). Couple one behind a tender, behind a tank engine or against a diesel and it keeps the engine topped up; chain them for more range, and park one as a remote water tower. Each car has a Feed checkbox in its Operations tab. The diesel car takes waybills: buy diesel for it at an interchange and deliver it to the diesel stands. Other mods can declare their own cars as aux cars. Also: remote MU, so a helper engine anywhere in the train follows the lead (in multiplayer, the host's setting rules). Required: it adds cars, so every player in a game needs it, at the same version. Buy them in the Equipment window; fill them at towers, coaling docks and fuel stands.
